bill.title: A bill to prohibit the Secretary of the Interior from taking any action to expand the Mid-Continent Limestone Quarry located near Glenwood Springs, Colorado.
bill.latestActionText: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

classification.plainSummary: This bill would prevent the Secretary of the Interior from taking any action to expand a specific limestone quarry located near Glenwood Springs, Colorado. It targets one named facility, the Mid-Continent Limestone Quarry, and would block federal approval or support for any expansion of that operation. The bill does not address quarrying generally or other facilities.

industries.rationale: The bill directly prohibits expansion of a limestone quarry, affecting quarrying operations and materials extraction at that site.
Limestone quarries supply aggregate and materials for construction projects, so limiting this quarry's expansion could affect regional material supply.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
